name: view_duel_uncork_after_my_last_clear
description: In the Surge's last wave my hollow clears while the rival's still waits for my corked bottles (SimUndertow.holds), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. My hollow is done (Game.State.WON) but the duel is not decided, and the simulation still takes an UNCORK from my seat: Space uncorks my first bottle, and the client uncorks the second itself at 24 s, neither refused with 'The match is over' (Game._uncork_order_refusal). Every other order stays shut once my hollow is done (Game.over(), order_refusal()): no build, fork, sell, signal, Ready, cork or Seawall goes out, and the card stays grey.

steps.msg: a tower of mine to fork and sell later

steps.assert: corks[0] > 0 and corks[1] > 0 and Game.my_bottles().size() == 2 and Game.my_bottles()[0]['known'] and Game.my_bottles()[1]['known'] and scene.tower_at(cell) != null
steps.msg: my two bottles for wave 15 stand with their salts, and my tower

steps.assert: Game.state == Game.State.WON and Game.duel_wave() and Game.outcome() == '' and Game.sim.tick < horn + 1400 and Game.sim.tick >= Game.sim.uncork_tick()
steps.msg: my hollow is done before 24 s, the rival's wave still runs, nothing is decided
my bottles still hold the rival's wave
the client may uncork them, as the simulation takes it

steps.assert: Game.over() and Game.order_refusal() == 'The match is over' and Game.cork_refusal('swarm') == 'The match is over' and Game.seawall_refusal() == 'The match is over'
steps.msg: every other order is shut: my hollow is done

steps.assert: not scene.build(Game.kit_tower(0), cell + Vector2i(1, 0)) and not scene.fork(cell) and not scene.sell(cell)
steps.msg: no build, fork or sell goes out

steps.assert: not scene.controller.arm_signal() and not scene.controller.toggle_ready() and not scene.controller.seawall()
node('Hud').card()[0]['state'] == 'idle' and node('Hud').card()[3]['state'] == 'idle' and node('Hud').card()[5]['state'] == 'idle' and node('Hud').end_plate().is_empty()
steps.msg: the card stays grey, and no end plate before the decision
the simulation took it from my done hollow's seat
at 24 s the client uncorked the second itself: nothing fizzled

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 1).size() + resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 2).size() + resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 3).size() + resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 4).size() + resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 5).size() == orders_before and Game.order_refusal() == 'The match is over'
steps.msg: and no other order of mine reached the turns
